description: Machine-readable egress thresholds consumed by the deterministic egress checker (S1.1). Values are the 2021 IRC baseline; the HomeModel schema uses meters, so metric values are authoritative for computation and imperial values are the as-codified citations.
jurisdiction_note: The IRC is a model code; adopted editions and local amendments vary by jurisdiction. These values are general guidance, not a substitute for the locally adopted code.

min_net_clear_opening_area.note: Net clear opening when open, not glass size. Must be checked independently of height/width minimums.

min_net_clear_opening_area_grade_floor.note: Reduced minimum for grade-floor or below-grade openings.

max_sill_height.note: Maximum height of the clear opening's bottom above the floor for a window serving as the emergency escape opening.

rooms_requiring_escape_opening.note: Every sleeping room requires at least one operable emergency escape and rescue opening; the app applies this to rooms typed 'bedroom'.
